fullPassage: As part of a kindness project, Orange High School students wrote cheerful letters to elders in a countryside village. Anna wrote to Mrs. Pike. She shared about her balcony garden at home and included drawings of flowers. Anna mentioned that despite having limited space, she enjoyed taking care of her plants. Her letter concluded by expressing hope that Mrs. Pike also had a nice garden. After sending the letter, Anna forgot about it until a month later when a package arrived at her home. Anna noticed the box in front of her door. She walked closer and saw it was addressed to her. When Anna opened it, she found a folded letter and a jar of homemade strawberry mint jam from Mrs. Pike. She wrote, "Your words made me smile. I used to have a garden, but when my husband died, I stopped planting. Your letter reminded me how much I missed it. So I planted some herbs. Have a taste!" The letter was signed, "Love, Mrs. Pike." Anna was deeply moved by Mrs. Pike's response. When her teacher announced that her class would visit the village to meet the seniors, Anna was thrilled. As they arrived, Mrs. Pike warmly greeted Anna with open arms. She pointed to a green space beside her house, saying, "Look at my herbs." Anna smiled and commented on how wonderful they must smell. Together, they spent the day planting seeds. Mrs. Pike even gave Anna some herbs to take home. Mrs. Pike thanked Anna for brightening her spirit. After the visit, Anna continued writing to Mrs. Pike every month. She also started a gardening club where students planted seeds in recycled jars and cups. Anna used the empty jam jar to plant some rosemary, which reminded her of Mrs. Pike's herb garden. The rosemary grew by the window. Whenever Anna looked at it, she had a warm feeling. It was a daily reminder that people, like plants, sometimes just need a little sunlight.

Her letter concluded by expressing hope that Mrs. Pike also had a nice garden. After sending the letter, Anna forgot about it until a month later when a package arrived at her home. Anna noticed the box in front of her door. She walked closer and saw it was addressed to her. When Anna opened it, she found a folded letter and a jar of homemade strawberry mint jam from Mrs. Pike. She wrote, "Your words made me smile. I used to have a garden, but when my husband died, I stopped planting. Your letter reminded me how much I missed it. So I planted some herbs. Have a taste!" The letter was signed, "Love, Mrs. Pike." Anna was deeply moved by Mrs. Pike's response. When her teacher announced that her class would visit the village to meet the seniors, Anna was thrilled. As they arrived, Mrs. Pike warmly greeted Anna with open arms. She pointed to a green space beside her house, saying, "Look at my herbs." Anna smiled and <u>commented</u> on how wonderful they must smell. Together, they spent the day planting seeds. Mrs. Pike even gave Anna some herbs to take home. Mrs. Pike thanked Anna for brightening her spirit. After the visit, Anna continued writing to Mrs. Pike every month. She also started a gardening club where students planted seeds in recycled jars and cups. Anna used the empty jam jar to plant some rosemary, which reminded her of Mrs. Pike's herb garden. The rosemary grew by the window. Whenever Anna looked at it, she had a warm feeling. It was a daily reminder that people, like plants, sometimes just need a little sunlight.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>commented</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
① complained(불평했다): 부정적 뉘앙스로 다른 의미
② whispered(속삭였다): 말하는 방식이지 의미가 다름
③ remarked ←정답: commented와 같이 '말했다, 언급했다'는 의미
④ hesitated(망설였다): commented와 무관
det.tip: commented(언급했다) = remarked(언급했다)

① recalled ←정답: forgot(잊다)의 반의어로 '기억해내다'
② ignored(무시했다): 잊는 것과 유사하지만 의도적 행동

④ repeated(반복했다): forgot과 무관

questions.passage:
(A) So I <u>planted</u> some herbs. Have a taste!

(1) The manager decided to <u>plant</u> new trees along the road to provide shade.
(2) The spy tried to <u>plant</u> false evidence at the crime scene.
(3) The workers built a large power <u>plant</u> near the river.
(4) She always <u>plants</u> a kiss on her child's forehead before bedtime.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 plant가 (A)와 같은 의미로 쓰인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① The manager decided to plant new trees along the road to provide shade. ←정답
❌ ② The spy tried to plant false evidence at the crime scene.
❌ ③ The workers built a large power plant near the river.
❌ ④ She always plants a kiss on her child's forehead before bedtime.

(1) The manager decided to plant new trees. ←정답: '(나무를) 심다'로 (A)와 동일한 의미
(2) The spy tried to plant false evidence. — '(증거를) 조작하여 심어놓다'로 비유적 의미
(3) The workers built a large power plant. — '(발전)소, 공장'이라는 명사 의미
(4) She always plants a kiss. — 'plants a kiss(입맞춤을 하다)'는 관용표현
det.tip: (A)의 planted = 허브를 심었다. (1)의 plant = 나무를 심다. 둘 다 식물을 심는 행위

ch: The manager decided to plant new trees along the road to provide shade.
The spy tried to plant false evidence at the crime scene.
The workers built a large power plant near the river.
She always plants a kiss on her child's forehead before bedtime.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a container made of glass, typically with a wide opening, used for storing food"

det.korean: 유리로 만든, 입이 넓은, 음식 저장용 용기
det.analysis:
① pot(냄비/화분): 유리가 아닌 도자기/금속 용기
② vase(꽃병): 꽃을 꽂는 용도이지 음식 저장 아님
③ barrel(통): 크고 나무/금속으로 된 통으로 jar와 다름
④ jar ←정답: 유리로 만든 입이 넓은 음식 저장 용기
det.tip: glass + wide opening + storing food = jar(유리병)

questions.passage: She shared about her balcony garden at home and included __________ (draw) of flowers.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 동사 draw를 명사 복수형 drawings로 변환. 'included ____ of flowers'에서 동사 include 뒤에 목적어(명사)가 필요하고, 꽃의 그림이 여러 장이므로 복수형이 적절하다.
det.tip: included + ____ + of flowers → 명사 복수 필요 → drawings

questions.passage: The letter was __________ (sign), "Love, Mrs. Pike." Anna was deeply moved by Mrs. Pike's response.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 동사 sign을 과거분사 signed로 변환. 'The letter was ____'에서 수동태(be + p.p.) 구문이므로 과거분사가 필요하다. 편지에 서명이 되어 있었다는 의미.
det.tip: was + ____ → 수동태 → signed
